$comment: Central definition of the five effort tiers (docs/effort.md). It lives inside the effort extension so the extension stays self-contained and extractable; the toolchain (packages/core/lib/effort.mjs, the autonomy runner, verify) reads this same file. Effort controls execution depth and breadth only: it never changes the model, its thinking level, the profile or any permission. Limits are defaults, not quotas to consume; users may lower or raise them in <agent dir>/pi-kit/effort.json within the platform ceilings below. Edit the numbers here, not in code.

recovery.$comment: A separate, small budget so a minimal-effort session can still recover from being stuck. It is only spendable while the trusted recovery extension has recovery active (the model cannot switch it on), only for read-only roles, and it never adds to the discretionary budget.
